bring_up_sequence.action: Upon reset, the AES unit will first reseed the internal PRNGs for register clearing and masking via EDN, and then clear all key, IV and data registers with pseudo-random data.
bring_up_sequence.description: Upon reset, the AES unit will first reseed the internal PRNGs for register clearing and masking via EDN, and then clear all key, IV and data registers with pseudo-random data.

bring_up_sequence.action: Only after this sequence has finished, the unit becomes idle (indicated in [STATUS.IDLE](registers.md#status)).
bring_up_sequence.description: Only after this sequence has finished, the unit becomes idle (indicated in [STATUS.IDLE](registers.md#status)).

bring_up_sequence.action: The AES unit is then ready for software initialization.
bring_up_sequence.description: The AES unit is then ready for software initialization.

bring_up_sequence.action: Before initialization, software must ensure that the AES unit is idle by checking [STATUS.IDLE](registers.md#status).
bring_up_sequence.description: Before initialization, software must ensure that the AES unit is idle by checking [STATUS.IDLE](registers.md#status).

bring_up_sequence.action: To initialize the AES unit, software must first provide the configuration to the [CTRL_SHADOWED](registers.md#ctrl_shadowed) register.
bring_up_sequence.description: To initialize the AES unit, software must first provide the configuration to the [CTRL_SHADOWED](registers.md#ctrl_shadowed) register.

bring_up_sequence.action: Since writing this register may initiate the reseeding of the internal PRNGs, software must check that the AES unit is idle before providing the initial key.
bring_up_sequence.description: Since writing this register may initiate the reseeding of the internal PRNGs, software must check that the AES unit is idle before providing the initial key.

bring_up_sequence.action: Then software must write the initial key to the Initial Key registers [KEY_SHARE0_0](registers.md#key_share0) - [KEY_SHARE1_7](registers.md#key_share1).
bring_up_sequence.description: Then software must write the initial key to the Initial Key registers [KEY_SHARE0_0](registers.md#key_share0) - [KEY_SHARE1_7](registers.md#key_share1).

bring_up_sequence.action: Independent of the selected key length, software must always write all 8 32-bit registers of both shares.
bring_up_sequence.description: Independent of the selected key length, software must always write all 8 32-bit registers of both shares.

bring_up_sequence.action: Each register must be written at least once.
bring_up_sequence.description: Each register must be written at least once.

bring_up_sequence.action: If running in CBC, CFB, OFB or CTR mode, software must also write the IV registers [IV_0](registers.md#iv) - [IV_3](registers.md#iv).
bring_up_sequence.description: If running in CBC, CFB, OFB or CTR mode, software must also write the IV registers [IV_0](registers.md#iv) - [IV_3](registers.md#iv).

bring_up_sequence.action: Since providing the initial key initiate the reseeding of the internal PRNGs, software must check that the AES unit is idle before writing the IV registers.
bring_up_sequence.description: Since providing the initial key initiate the reseeding of the internal PRNGs, software must check that the AES unit is idle before writing the IV registers.

bring_up_sequence.action: Each IV register must be written at least once.
bring_up_sequence.description: Each IV register must be written at least once.

bring_up_sequence.action: Note that the AES unit automatically updates the IV registers when running in CBC, CFB, OFB or CTR mode (after having consumed the current IV value).
bring_up_sequence.description: Note that the AES unit automatically updates the IV registers when running in CBC, CFB, OFB or CTR mode (after having consumed the current IV value).

bring_up_sequence.action: To start the encryption/decryption of a new message, software must wait for the AES unit to become idle and then provide new values to the IV registers.
bring_up_sequence.description: To start the encryption/decryption of a new message, software must wait for the AES unit to become idle and then provide new values to the IV registers.

bring_up_sequence.action: Automatically starts encryption/decryption when new input data is available.
bring_up_sequence.description: Automatically starts encryption/decryption when new input data is available.

bring_up_sequence.action: Does not overwrite previous output data that has not yet been read by the processor.
bring_up_sequence.description: Does not overwrite previous output data that has not yet been read by the processor.
